title: 第十一章 汉口镇的初遇
slug: 凡人修仙谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

侯紫没有往北走。

他当着孙墨的面说了句“往散修坊市去了”，转身走进暮色里。走出两里地，估摸着镇妖司的人已经走远了，他在岔路口停下。往北是山路，往南是官道。孙墨说往北，他就偏不往北。岳州城不是白混的，可不能轻易相信别人。

他拐上往南的官道，走了大半日，前面出现一条大江。江面宽阔，水势平缓，码头边停着几十条货船，挑夫们扛着粮袋在跳板上吆喝。江风吹过，带着水腥味和鱼鲜味，还有船工号子的回音。镇子沿江而建，街上挑担的、摆摊的、赶车的挤挤挨挨，酒楼门口挂着红灯笼，茶馆里传出说书先生的拍案声。

镇口石碑上刻着三个字，汉口镇。侯紫默念了一遍，觉得这名字比岳州城顺口，然后走进去。

侯紫找了家门脸不大的客栈，要了二楼临江的房间，拿出路引登记，付了两天的房钱。

进屋后把门插上，窗关了。背靠着门坐在地上，把怀里的东西全掏出来摆在面前，嘟囔着：憋坏了都。

银票、路引、三寸小剑、黑袍储物袋、白袍储物袋、破书。还有陆继那个打不开的储物袋，筑基修士的禁制太强，暂时动不了。

先倒出黑袍储物袋。二十个金元宝滚出来，在木地板上砸出沉闷的声响。五十个银锭子堆成一座小银山。珍珠滚了一地，鸽子蛋大，浑圆，在暗处都泛着淡光。三块翡翠绿得像刚从江水里捞出来的水草。他跪在地上重新数了一遍，和那晚在月光下数的一模一样，没少。

那件黑色的软甲，侯紫还是搞不懂。

侯紫嘿嘿的傻笑着。

拿起白袍储物袋倒了出来。四颗夜明珠滚出来，鹅蛋大，浑圆，在昏暗的房间里泛出柔和的淡绿色荧光，照得他脸上忽明忽暗。侯紫吸了一口气。

接着是二十颗石头，拇指大，半透明，握在手里微微发温。他放在桌上看了半天，猜不出是什么，只知道肯定不是普通石头。

然后是三个玉盒，盒盖上刻着他不认识的字。

第一个盒子里是淡绿色的药膏，闻着像金疮药。

第二个是三颗褐色药丸，几乎没味道。

第三个是两颗暗红色药丸，有极淡的苦香。他把玉盒一一合上，不敢乱吃。

还有一个小木盒，二个，针只有十一支。他数了两遍，想起黑袍脖子上那个极小的红点，无声地吸了口气，把盒盖小心合上。

一张兽皮地图，巴掌大，折叠着。展开后画着一片山脉，其中一处用朱砂圈了红圈，那两个死鬼应该就是为了这张图打起来的。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Hou Zi did not go north.

He said in front of Sun Mo, "I'm going to Sanxiufang City", turned around and walked into the dusk.After walking two miles, he guessed that the people from the Demon Suppression Division were far away, so he stopped at a fork in the road.To the north is the mountain road and to the south is the official road.Sun Mo said to go north, but he refused to go north.Yuezhou City is not free, and you can't trust others easily.

He turned onto the official road heading south and walked for more than half a day when a large river appeared in front of him.The river is wide and the water is gentle. There are dozens of cargo ships parked at the dock, and the porters are shouting on the springboard carrying grain bags.The river breeze blows by, bringing with it the smell of water and fish, as well as the echo of the boatmen's chants.The town is built along the river. People carrying burdens, setting up stalls, and driving cars are crowded in the streets. Red lanterns are hung at the entrances of restaurants, and the sound of storytellers can be heard in the teahouses.

Three words are engraved on the stone tablet at the entrance of the town, Hankou Town.Hou Zimo read it over and felt that the name was easier to read than Yuezhou City, and then walked in.

Hou Zi found a small inn and asked for a room on the second floor facing the river. He took out the roadmap to register and paid for two days' rent.

After entering the house, he locked the door and closed the window.He sat on the ground with his back against the door, took out all the things in his arms and placed them in front of him, muttering: I'm holding everything back.

Silver notes, road guide, three-inch sword, black robe storage bag, white robe storage bag, torn book.There is also the storage bag that Lu Ji cannot open. The restriction imposed by the foundation-building monk is too strong and he cannot move it for the time being.

First pour out the black robe storage bag.Twenty gold ingots rolled out and hit the wooden floor with a dull sound.Fifty silver ingots piled up into a small silver mountain.The pearls rolled all over the floor, and the pigeon eggs were big and round, glowing faintly in the dark.The three pieces of emerald are as green as water plants just fished out of the river.He knelt on the ground and counted again. It was exactly the same as he had counted under the moonlight that night, no less.

Hou Zi still couldn't figure out that black soft armor.

Hou Zi giggled.

Picked up the white robe storage bag and poured it out.Four luminous beads rolled out, as big as goose eggs and round, glowing with soft light green fluorescence in the dim room, illuminating his face.Hou Zi took a breath.

Then came twenty stones, thumb-sized, translucent, slightly warm in the hand.He put it on the table and looked at it for a long time. He couldn't guess what it was. He only knew that it was definitely not an ordinary stone.

Then there were three jade boxes with characters he didn't recognize engraved on the lids.

The first box contained a light green ointment that smelled like gold sore medicine.

The second was three brown pills, almost tasteless.

The third one is two dark red pills with a very light bitter aroma.He closed the jade boxes one by one and did not dare to eat randomly.

There is also a small wooden box, two, with only eleven needles.He counted it twice and remembered the tiny red dot on the neck of the black robe. He took a silent breath and carefully closed the lid of the box.

An animal skin map, as big as a palm, folded.After unfolding, a mountain range was drawn, one of which was circled in red with cinnabar. The two dead ghosts probably fought over this picture.
